targets.summary: A standalone PyWarningHandler is the wrong fix because it has to work together with exception handling (set_in_exception). The call should be wrapped in HANDLE_TH_ERRORS / END_HANDLE_TH_ERRORS_PYBIND, which handles both error translation and warnings.
targets.maintainer_comment:
I don't think this is the right fix. As this system is supposed to work in tandem with exeption handling to perform well (see .set_in_exception() and similar things).

I think a better fix here would be guard all of this call into the HANDLE_TH_ERROR macro and END_HANDLE_TH_ERROR_MACRO_PYBIND. That one handles error translation and warning in one go and ensure everything works well.
targets.human_label: yes: should be captured as a blocking issue
targets.labeler_note: This one will be hard to encode. It is quite indirect implications and trading off of BC-break for another.
